objective: Create a first real Brazilian startup dataset to calibrate AI maturity, NVIDIA recommendation fit, confidence, and briefing explanations.
notes: Expected labels are seed labels for human review, not final truth.
The backend should run URL ingestion for each primary website.
After the run, review AI maturity, evidence quality, top recommendations, confidence, and briefing content.
Non-AI items are controls: they should not receive strong technical NVIDIA recommendations unless strong evidence is found.

items.name: Dadosfera
items.why_in_dataset: Brazilian data and AI platform; useful to test Portuguese AI signals, agent wording, analytics and data stack recommendations.

items.name: NeuralMind
items.why_in_dataset: AI-first company focused on language/document intelligence; should test LLM/NLP fit.
